# PWA Installability Checker

> Free tool: run a CLI that fetches your page, its Web App Manifest, and every icon it lists, then paste the JSON here for a plain-English report against Chrome's installability criteria -- the same checks Lighthouse's installable-manifest audit runs, no Chrome required. Nothing uploaded.

Free and open source (MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.
